limitations: Pins are pending the final build.
Five cases (01, 04, 07, 14, 15) need release notes, which the current 18-source index lacks.
Passage observation is necessary, not sufficient; support, version scope and usefulness stay human judgments after the final run.
No pytest reads these files, so the development suite never opens held-out content; the evaluation owner verifies them with the runner and the registration hashes.
11 test fixtures (12 turns) carry the escalation amendment; their final hashes differ from the reviewed hashes only in escalate conditions (and case 03 also in its reviewed passage alternative).
